```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# The theme file goes next to this document; the figures are saved at the
# size of the theme's slots and placed with the theme's own commands.
library(ggplot2)
library(infereportR)
file.copy(deck_theme_file("beamer"), ".", overwrite = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.show = "hide")
inch <- function(preset) unlist(figure_size(preset)[c("width", "height")]) / 25.4
side <- inch("slide_side")
half <- inch("slide_half")
full <- inch("slide_full")
plot_slide <- ggplot(PlantGrowth, aes(group, weight)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  theme_figure("slide") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Dried weight (g)")
```

# Results

## Treatment 2 plants weigh the most

```{r side, fig.width = side[[1]], fig.height = side[[2]]}
plot_slide
```

\sidefigure[0.64]{\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{`r knitr::fig_chunk("side", "pdf")`}}
  {Every plant is shown, by treatment group.\par\medskip
   \smalllabel{Rule}\par Show the data, then the summary.}
\source{R datasets: PlantGrowth.}
